Took three edits to hit the description (60-160) and seo_title (70) limits; a character count in the error that says how many to cut would save a round.
`git add -A` inside an experiment directory picked up a SMOKE=1 `.cache_smoke/` and `results_smoke.*`, which earlier milestones keep out of git without any gitignore entry; nothing warns.
